 Singapore to host Southeast Asia's only BTS THE CITY ARIRANG experience in 2026
 Singapore will host BTS THE CITY ARIRANG from December 1 to 31, 2026, in partnership with HYBE, marking the project's only Southeast Asian stop this year. The island-wide programme will feature themed installations, light shows, art trails and music-led experiences across major attractions, building up to BTS' four sold-out concerts at the National Stadium in December.

 ETTravelWorld 
 Updated On Oct 22, 2026 at 10:00 AM IST
 3 min read
 -->
 Singapore will host BTS THE CITY ARIRANG from December 1 to 31, 2026, following a partnership between the Singapore Tourism Board (STB) and HYBE . The month-long programme marks the project's first and only stop in Southeast Asia in 2026 and will coincide with BTS' return to Singapore for four sold-out concerts at the National Stadium.
The concerts are scheduled for December 17, 19, 20 and 22. The wider initiative will extend the concert experience beyond the stadium through themed installations, music-led attractions and interactive activities across multiple locations, positioning the city as a destination for international fans.
 Advt 
 BTS THE CITY ARIRANG is HYBE's city-wide experience format, designed to transform host destinations through coordinated events and installations linked to the group's music and the BTS WORLD TOUR ARIRANG. First staged in Seoul in March 2026, the project has since visited Las Vegas, Busan, London and New York. Singapore will be its first and only Southeast Asian destination this year.

The Singapore edition will involve several tourism and lifestyle destinations, including Jewel Changi Airport, Mandai Wildlife Reserve , National Gallery Singapore, National Museum of Singapore, Resorts World Sentosa , Sentosa Development Corporation, The Kallang Group and Zouk Singapore.
 Planned highlights include a themed light and music show at Jewel Changi Airport's Rain Vortex and a landmark-themed takeover of Exploria, a new immersive multimedia attraction at Mandai Wildlife Reserve. National Gallery Singapore will present an art trail pairing BTS music with works featured in Pop after Pop: Art around Us, while the National Museum of Singapore will host themed light and sound installations.
 Advt 
 At Resorts World Sentosa, Universal Studios Singapore will feature a fireworks display choreographed to BTS music alongside other themed experiences. Sentosa Island will host a music-led rave and drone show, a themed race and immersive installations. The Kallang will offer interactive experiences across themed zones, while Zouk Singapore will stage opening and closing night takeovers featuring dedicated music and experiential programming.
 The programme will also extend to Singapore's waterfront and urban landmarks. From December 8 to 22, several locations around Marina Bay and the Singapore River will be illuminated in ARIRANG red each night. These include Gardens by the Bay, Singapore Flyer, The Fullerton Hotel Singapore, The Helix Bridge, Anderson Bridge and Cavenagh Bridge, among other landmarks.
 Oliver Chong, Assistant Chief Executive, International Group, STB, said, "This is the largest city-wide destination project we have collaborated on with a partner for any recording artist, and we are proud to bring this exclusive experience to the region for the first time. Hosting the Southeast Asian debut of 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG' is a testament to our ability to attract some of the world's most iconic IPs, reinforcing Singapore's position as a premier destination for world-class live entertainment. We look forward to welcoming BTS fans from across the world to Singapore this December."
 The initiative builds on STB's partnership with HYBE and its labels, which began in 2024 and has included social media content, events featuring K-pop artistes and music video productions showcasing Singapore's landmarks and attractions.
HYBE said the Singapore edition would be the final stop of BTS THE CITY ARIRANG in 2026, extending the concert experience across the city and bringing fans and visitors together through music-related activities. Further details about participating partners and individual activations will be announced later.
The programme is expected to add to Singapore's December events calendar, combining live music, cultural attractions and entertainment experiences to encourage visitors to explore multiple parts of the city during the concert period.
